name: Louis Rosario
review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match on every must-have - bilingual, Florida-based, and 20 years of regulatory/administrative experience in health and human-services settings.
**Strengths:** Fluent English/Spanish; recently relocated to FL; current role as a CT Dept of Public Health Quality Review Specialist plus years as a Mental Health Information Officer doing statutory investigations in psychiatric facilities - directly relevant to sensitive, documentation-heavy coordination work. Comp expectation ($19/hr) is in range.
**Gaps:** No adolescent-specific (13-17) experience listed, though the intake/documentation/compliance skill set transfers well.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies - resume and questionnaire align (relocation to FL matches recent move, employment dates line up).
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Several short stints in the CT state system (each under 2 years) as he moved between roles there - reads as internal promotion/reassignment rather than instability, worth a quick confirm at phone screen.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen.

name: Enriette Barbara
review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match - bilingual, Florida-based, with directly relevant intake/relations experience in a residential recovery setting.
**Strengths:** Fluent English/Spanish; FL-based; Assistant Supervisor of Intake Relations & Communications at Calvary House for Women (a residential recovery program) - handled Spanish-language intake calls directly. Comp expectation ($18/hr) in range.
**Gaps:** No adolescent-specific experience; most recent role (customer service, health insurance) is more general.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies - her stated reason for leaving (newborn's health issues, long commute) lines up with the employment gap since March 2025.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Gap since March 2025 (about a year and a half) - she explains this in her own answer (childcare/newborn health), consistent with the timeline; still worth a light touch at phone screen to confirm current availability.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen.

name: Lynda Valois
review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match - bilingual, Florida-based, with intake/patient coordination experience in a clinical (ABA) setting.
**Strengths:** Fluent English/Spanish; FL-based; Patient and Client Services Coordinator at Spring Health ABA Center - coordinated intake, scheduling, and authorizations for English- and Spanish-speaking families in a clinical setting, closely mirroring this role. Comp expectation ($19/hr) in range.
**Gaps:** No adolescent-specific (13-17) experience; ABA population may skew younger than 13-17.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies - her stated reason for leaving (employer paused operations and closed) is a clean, verifiable explanation.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen.

name: Viviana Morales
review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match - bilingual, Florida-based, with case management and crisis-response experience at a known FL behavioral health system.
**Strengths:** Fluent English/Spanish; FL-based; four progressive roles at Banyan Health Systems (Intake Coordinator -> Call Center Supervisor -> MRT Screener -> Case Manager), including direct behavioral-health crisis response and an actual Intake Coordinator title. Comp expectation ($19/hr) in range.
**Gaps:** No adolescent-specific (13-17) experience called out, though Banyan serves a broad population.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies. Reason for leaving is vague ("personal decision, will explain in interview") - not a red flag, just something to ask about directly.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable - steady progression at one employer for ~5 years.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen.

name: Ann Marie Serrano
review:
**Fit summary:** Very strong match - bilingual, Florida-based, 20+ years in intake/case management, with a title (Intake Specialist) that directly mirrors this role.
**Strengths:** Fluent English/Spanish; FL-based; current Intake Specialist at EmployU; prior Patient Care Coordinator at SMA Healthcare (FL behavioral health provider) handling crisis calls and intakes; Bilingual Parent Educator background. Comp expectation ($19/hr+) in range.
**Gaps:** None significant against the must-haves.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** She's currently full-time at EmployU and states she isn't planning to leave that job - she's exploring this as a part-time addition. Worth confirming schedule compatibility (this role's hours: Mon 3-6p, Tue-Thu 2-7p, Fri 3-6p EST) against her current job at phone screen, since availability is a stated non-negotiable.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - strongest applicant in this batch on paper, contingent on confirming schedule fit.

name: Angelina Malespin
review:
**Fit summary:** Weak match - based in New York (not Florida) and Spanish fluency is conversational, not fluent; both are stated non-negotiables for this role.
**Strengths:** Bachelor's in Psychology/Sociology (in progress, 3.99 GPA); paraprofessional experience with special-needs students; comfortable with background check/drug test and recording consent.
**Gaps:** Not Florida-based (address is Oakland Gardens, NY) - this role requires a private home workspace in FL, confirmed at phone screen. Spanish fluency is "conversational," not the fluent/bilingual level the role calls for. No adolescent-specific (13-17) or intake/scheduling experience.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable - recent grad-level work history.
**Recommendation:** Not clearly a fit given the location and fluency mismatches - leaving as a discussion point rather than disqualifying outright, since she's otherwise engaged and responsive; recommend confirming location/relocation plans before advancing.

name: Mercedes Melgar
review:
**Fit summary:** Likely a strong match on background, but the application is missing key screening answers (no address, no questionnaire responses) needed to confirm the must-haves.
**Strengths:** Headline states "Outreach Bilingual Specialist @ Catholic Charities"; prior Intake Manager (Dept of Social Services) and Administrative Assistant (child/family documentation) - directly relevant intake and family-services background.
**Gaps:** Spanish fluency level and Florida residency aren't confirmed anywhere in the application (blank address, empty questionnaire) - both are non-negotiables that need direct confirmation before proceeding.
**Consistency check:** N/A - insufficient data.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Employment appears continuous (2012-2025) across three roles; no gaps evident.
**Recommendation:** Phone screen to confirm fluency and FL residency directly - background looks strong enough to be worth the call.

name: Ysabel Camara
review:

**Strengths:** FL-based (Palm Bay); Patient Financial Service Representative at Memorial Healthcare - patient intake scheduling and insurance verification in a clinical setting; comfortable with background check/drug test.
**Gaps:** Spanish fluency ("Basic") is a clear gap against the stated must-have of fluent/bilingual. Requested pay ($14-16/hr) is below this role's range ($17-19/hr) - worth clarifying if she saw the correct posting.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable.
**Recommendation:** Comment-only, likely not a fit given the fluency gap - defer to phone screen if Devanne wants to confirm conversational ability directly rather than rule out on the questionnaire response alone.

name: Jocelyn Trujillo
review:
**Fit summary:** Likely strong match on background (bilingual case management in healthcare settings), but Florida residency isn't confirmed in the application.
**Strengths:** Self-described bilingual (English/Spanish); Case Management Analyst Coordinator (remote) at Aetna and Member Services Representative at Inland Empire Health Plan - both healthcare case management/intake-adjacent roles.
**Gaps:** No address on file, so Florida residency (a non-negotiable) isn't confirmed. Work history is entirely California-based employers, which raises the location question rather than answering it.

**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable - steady employment history.
**Recommendation:** Phone screen to confirm Florida residency and fluency level directly before proceeding further.

name: Yazmari Mas Coll
review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match on background - direct bilingual behavioral health and intake experience, including a Mental Health Technician role - though Florida residency isn't stated in the application.
**Strengths:** Multiple bilingual roles (Registered Behavior Technician, Bilingual Daily Living Consultant, Bilingual Service Coordinator); prior Mental Health Technician at Holly Hill Hospital; Bachelor's in Psychology; currently pursuing a Community Spanish Interpreter diploma - unusually strong direct fit for this role's communication and adolescent/behavioral-health context.
**Gaps:** No address on file to confirm Florida residency.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Several roles under a year each (Service Coordinator, Teacher, Daily Living Consultant) - reads as normal early-career movement across adjacent fields rather than a concerning pattern; worth a light touch at phone screen.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - one of the stronger background fits in this batch, contingent on confirming FL residency.

name: Leeyan
review:
**Fit summary:** Not a match - based overseas (Abu Dhabi / Quezon City, Philippines), not Florida, and Spanish fluency is "Basic," not the fluent/bilingual level required.
**Strengths:** HR/compliance coordination background; comfortable with background check and recording consent.
**Gaps:** Not US-based at all, let alone Florida - this role requires a private home workspace in FL and specific EST working hours, which isn't logistically compatible with a UAE/Philippines base. Spanish fluency ("Basic") also falls short of the required level. No relevant intake, healthcare, or adolescent-services background.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable.
**Recommendation:** Not a fit - the overseas location alone makes this role logistically unworkable, compounded by the fluency gap. Recommend against advancing, though leaving the final call with Devanne rather than auto-disqualifying given no location-based disqualify precedent exists yet for this role.

review:
**Fit summary:** Strong match on background - a current Bilingual Intake Specialist with autism-services experience - though Florida residency isn't confirmed in the application.
**Strengths:** Bilingual Intake Specialist at Families First (client assessments, program intake, treatment planning); prior Behavioral Technician at Propel Autism - directly relevant to intake coordination and the adolescent behavioral-health context.
**Gaps:** No address on file to confirm Florida residency.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.

**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - strong background fit, contingent on confirming FL residency.

name: Noelea Dantonio
review:
**Fit summary:** Very strong clinical/counseling background (arguably overqualified for this coordinator-level role), but Florida residency and current Spanish fluency level aren't confirmed in the application.
**Strengths:** Current per-diem Group Counselor at an IOP program; extensive counseling and bilingual guidance-counselor history including work in English and Spanish; Master's in Psychological Counseling.
**Gaps:** No address on file - work history is New York/New Jersey-based (NYC Board of Ed, GenPsych), so Florida residency needs direct confirmation, not assumption. Most bilingual-specific work (NYC Board of Ed) was decades ago; current fluency level isn't restated.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Long, varied career spanning 1995-2026 across counseling and case management roles - no concerning gaps, reads as a deep, stable background in the field.
**Recommendation:** Phone screen to confirm Florida residency and current Spanish fluency - if both check out, this is a very strong clinical background for a coordinator role, possibly worth discussing fit/level directly.

name: Anne Jean
review:
**Fit summary:** Excellent match - already at Phone Screen with directly relevant bilingual hospital intake experience for adolescents and families.
**Strengths:** Intake Coordinator (per diem) at Bay Ridge Hospital handling behavioral-health patient intake for adolescents and families; Bilingual Customer Service Representative at Automated Health Systems supporting adolescent clients; Patient Care Representative at Cambridge Health Alliance. Directly on-target background.
**Gaps:** None significant against the must-haves based on the application.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable - steady progression through healthcare intake/patient-facing roles.
**Recommendation:** Strong candidate - continue with the standard next step for her current stage (already past resume screening).

name: Charlotte Cross
review:
_Reviewed against the Operations Manager hiring guide (the current standing guide for this role, per Devanne 2026-09-24)._

**Fit summary:** Solid match on program leadership and compliance ownership; gap on EHR experience specifically.
**Strengths:** 10+ years running youth-program operations end to end - led startup, implementation, and full compliance for two federal SRAE grants (program infrastructure, reporting systems, regulatory compliance from scratch); directly supervised 17 after-school staff plus 4 full-time case managers at YMCA (more than 10 employees, per her own answer) - clearly meets the "owner, not support" and supervisory must-haves.
**Gaps:** No EHR experience mentioned (used an applicant tracking system, not a clinical/health EHR). Census/occupancy-specific language isn't used, though she describes coordinating case management for 50+ participants, which is adjacent. Spanish fluency is "Basic," not fluent.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies - her explanation for the DoorDash gap (high-risk pregnancy, now transitioning back) is consistent throughout.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Gap in traditional employment from mid-2022 to present (contracting via DoorDash) - she explains this directly and consistently; not a red flag, just confirm current availability at phone screen.
**Recommendation:** Phone screen - strong operational/compliance leadership background; confirm EHR/scheduling-system experience directly since that's a stated must-have.

name: Daniela Wittenberg
review:
_Reviewed against the Operations Manager hiring guide (the current standing guide for this role, per Devanne 2026-09-24). Note: my first pass reviewed this candidate against the wrong framework (general adolescent-services judgment, not the actual Ops Manager must-haves) - this replaces that review with a more accurate one._

**Fit summary:** Meaningful gap - she has strong direct-service experience with adolescents but has never supervised anyone, which is an explicit must-have for this role.
**Strengths:** 4 years managing a caseload of 15-18 adolescents through a structured case-management model, working across DCF, schools, and juvenile justice systems; bilingual (fluent); already trains/supports peer Life Coaches informally; pursuing MS in Clinical Mental Health Counseling; meets the 1+ year healthcare/human-services must-have clearly.
**Gaps:** Answered "None" to "how many employees have you directly supervised" - this role's must-have is 1+ year formally supervising or leading a team with direct reports. No EHR, census/occupancy, or compliance-documentation experience mentioned. Her current role is direct service, not operations/program ownership.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** None notable - steady 4-year tenure at current employer.
**Recommendation:** Not a clear fit for this specific Operations Manager posting given the supervisory-experience gap is a stated must-have, not a strong-plus - but she's clearly a strong adolescent-services candidate; worth flagging to Devanne in case this was intended for a different, more direct-service-focused opening, since her background doesn't match an operations-manager scope. Leaving as comment-only rather than disqualifying, since she's engaged and the mismatch may be a role-targeting question rather than a candidate-quality one.

name: Jessica Blaine
review:
_Reviewed against the Clinical Director hiring guide (the current standing guide for this role, per Devanne 2026-09-24). She's already at Phone Screen, so this is comment-only regardless - the auto-disqualify logic never applies past the Applied stage._

**Fit summary:** Significant gap - nothing in her application indicates she holds an active Florida LMHC, LCSW, or LMFT license, which this role's guide states as a non-negotiable must-have ("no exceptions").
**Strengths:** 15+ years of progressive healthcare operations leadership; built and scaled a Medical Services department from scratch; led hiring, staffing, and compliance functions across multiple healthcare organizations; comfortable owning business/financial operations.
**Gaps:** Her titles and history (Clinical Operations Lead, Operations Manager, Registered Medical Assistant, Triage Nurse - credential unspecified) read as an operations/admin career, not a licensed therapist track. Her degrees are Health Administration and Health Sciences, not a clinical mental-health master's (which LMHC/LCSW/LMFT require). No Spanish fluency. Disclosed a prior misdemeanor/felony/arrest on the standard screening question (no detail given - route through the normal background-check process, not reflected as a judgment here).
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies - stated reason for leaving (layoff) and supervisor contact are both provided and check out.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Returned to the same employer (Pediatric and Family Behavioral Health) twice with an Operations Manager stint elsewhere in between - reads as a boomerang hire, not instability.
**Recommendation:** Flagging clearly rather than acting on it: if this role truly requires an active FL clinical license (LMHC/LCSW/LMFT), her application doesn't show she holds one - worth confirming directly before she moves further, since a strong operations background doesn't substitute for the license this guide calls a non-negotiable.

name: Carl LePierre
review:
_Reviewed against the Lead Wellness Coordinator hiring guide (the standing guide Devanne pointed to for this role, 2026-09-24)._

**Fit summary:** Strong background match on behavioral-health/youth experience, but Spanish fluency specifically (not just "bilingual") isn't confirmed anywhere in the application.
**Strengths:** 2+ years directly in behavioral health/youth services (Counselor at Goodwill doing intake and psychosocial evaluations; concurrent part-time Behavioral Assistant with children/young adults since 2018; case support for individuals with autism/ADHD/intellectual disabilities); education well beyond the HS diploma/GED minimum.
**Gaps:** The guide's bilingual must-have is specifically English/Spanish - his application doesn't state a language, and his education (a Haitian university) suggests his second language may be French or Haitian Creole rather than Spanish. No explicit formal leadership/team-lead title, and no clear description of facilitating structured groups (his work is more individual case coordination).
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies noted, though the application is missing the standard questionnaire (no responses on file), so there's less to cross-check than usual.
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Currently lists two roles as concurrent (Counselor and part-time Behavioral Assistant) - worth a quick clarifying question on current employment status; no short-stay pattern otherwise.
**Recommendation:** Phone screen to directly confirm Spanish fluency specifically (not just "bilingual") and group-facilitation experience - strong behavioral-health background otherwise, but those two must-haves need a direct answer, not an assumption.

name: Gabriel Schettini
review:
_Reviewed against the Lead Wellness Coordinator hiring guide (the standing guide Devanne pointed to for this role, 2026-09-24)._

**Fit summary:** Very strong match - explicitly bilingual (English/Spanish), 13+ years of behavioral health case management including direct group-facilitation and informal leadership experience.
**Strengths:** Bilingual English/Spanish (stated directly); rebuilt and ran a youth behavioral-health case-management program with "substantial independence" after an agency transition; designed and ran therapeutic groups for youth - a direct match on the group-facilitation must-have; Targeted Case Manager for severely emotionally disturbed (SED) youth and families; well beyond the HS diploma/GED minimum.
**Gaps:** No formal "team lead" or supervisory title specifically, though the program-rebuild work implies real ownership and informal leadership.
**Consistency check:** No discrepancies, though the application is missing the standard questionnaire (no responses on file).
**Tenure/timeline notes:** Long, stable tenures throughout (7.5 years at current role, 3.5 years and 8 months at the two before that) - no short-stay pattern.
**Recommendation:** Advance to phone screen - the strongest fit against this role's actual must-haves in this batch.
